alexcrichton opened PR #14954 from alexcrichton:reject-async-types to bytecodealliance:main:

This commit extends the restrictions of Func::call, which already disallow async-lifted functions, to additionally disallow async-typed functions. These functions require the full event loop to be running to correctly implement the component model.

This is along the same lines as #14950 where we might want to deprecate Func::call eventually...
